fusions.name: Full-Draw Lunge
fusions.desc: A lunge loosed at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 26 damage, up to 2 times that at full range, and is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Waterline Pin
fusions.desc: Looses a barbed bolt that deals 4 damage, with a 20% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn and Still
fusions.desc: After holding still for 2 seconds, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Held Tension
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next ability deals 40% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
